properties.decision:
ANTHONY, 2026-10-05, verbatim: "I'll never be able to that amount of open decisions and structural gaps and structural defects - I'm going to turn this over to you to clean these up. Maybe do a first quick pass of things that are just obvious to close or address easily; note the ones that maybe have some uncertainty. Then after the first pass, it might make the second pass easier, so go again through them and close as many as you can (make a reasonable/rational judgement). Hopefully, on the third pass, you are left with ones that I truly need to make a decision on how to proceed forth. Always keep in mind that what reflow2's main vision/goals/objectives are and this should be the lens through what you make your judgement by"

WHAT THIS SETTLES. The cleanup of reflow2's own open decisions, gaps and defects is delegated, in three passes. Pass 1 closes only what the design itself proves: a question promoted into accepted intent, a decision an accepted successor replaced, an idea that is built, a defect whose condition no longer holds when measured, a report whose findings are already recorded. Pass 2 closes what a reasonable, rational judgement can, read through reflow2's vision. Pass 3 is the list left for him: what he truly needs to decide.

EVERY CLOSURE MADE IN THESE PASSES IS MADE UNDER THIS DECISION AND CITES IT, in its `chose` or its note. Anything uncertain, and anything whose closure would change direction, is left open for him. Nothing is deleted: a closure is a status move (or an INVALIDATES, a CAUSES back-edge, an acknowledgement) with its reason recorded.
properties.name: The owner hands the design-record cleanup to the agent: close what the design proves, judge what it reasonably can, and leave him only the real decisions
properties.rationale: On origin/main's committed design (6,761 nodes, 44,732 edges) the record held 393 proposed Decisions, 213 gaps and 132 defects: more open items than one person can work through, and the stale ones drown the real ones, which defeats req:the-tool-finds-its-own-blind-spots. The lens for every judgement is reflow2's own vision: proj:reflow2's objective (keep a design coherent from concept through operations), docs/vision.md, req:coherence, req:released-eq-designed, req:intent-preserved and req:human-decides. A record that still says 'open' about built or promoted work is itself drift; and a direction change stays the owner's call.
